notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes say she talked with Madison Arnzen Apr. 21 and Madison would contact the head person in charge and call Dave. Gmail shows repeated prior outreach and a 2024 response that inflatables were already rented but Adventure Zone information would be kept for the next year. Source: handwritten call notes, page 68; Adventure Zone Gmail.
